# Retention Policy

## Scope

This policy applies to all customer records created on or after January 2026.
Records predating this cutoff follow the legacy policy, archived separately.

## Timelines

Customer transactional records are retained for seven years from the date of
the last recorded transaction. Marketing engagement logs are retained for
eighteen months.

### Exceptions

Records subject to active legal hold are retained indefinitely until the hold
is released by the legal team. Export compliance records follow a parallel
ten-year schedule governed by regulation 15 CFR 762.

## Deletion

Approved deletion requests enter a thirty-day grace window before the record
is purged from primary and backup stores.
